name: DataLook.io

sources.title: Homepage — live directory but dominated by NSFW AI-girlfriend/companion affiliate listings
Submit Tool — paid-only: Basic $199, Featured $399, +$100 NSFW surcharge; Stripe payment before review

requirements: AI tool; must be functional with a clear value proposition, no spam/misleading content
Payment is required BEFORE review: Basic $199 (standard placement) or Featured $399 (homepage + top placement + social/newsletter)
NSFW tools pay a +$100 surcharge and must be flagged via the NSFW checkbox
No illegal/hate/harmful content; submitter must own or license submitted materials
Form fields: Tool Name, Tool URL, Detailed Description, Key Features, Logo URL (200x200), Screenshot URLs (1200x800), Contact Name/Email, Company Name
preparation: Hosted logo URL (200x200 PNG/JPG) and screenshot URLs (1200x800) — the form takes URLs, not uploads
$199-$499 budget depending on tier + NSFW flag
workflow: Fill Tool Information, Media & Assets, and Contact Information
Select Basic or Featured package, tick NSFW if applicable
Pay via Stripe, then the manual review runs (claimed 2-3 business days)
watchFor: The directory is overwhelmingly adult-content affiliate listings — brand adjacency risk for mainstream SaaS
Pay-before-review model; refund promised on rejection but trust is on the site operator
'Minor updates free; major changes may require re-review' — edits can trigger another review cycle
Low-quality inventory (duplicate tool entries on homepage); the claimed 'thousands of data professionals' audience is dubious for a mainstream product
Sitemap shows most non-adult categories have 0 tools — thin directory outside the NSFW niche
countsAsLive: The tool has a public detail page under datalook.io/ai-tools/ reachable from category listings
unknowns: Actual reviewer rigor — categories are mostly empty outside adult niches
